title: A J Packaging IPO
summary: A J Packaging IPO is a ₹54 crore book-built issue priced at ₹175–₹180 per share, to be listed on NSE SME. The IPO opens on December 1, 2026 and closes on December 3, 2026, with allotment expected on December 4 and listing on December 8, 2026. The minimum investment is ₹2,88,000 for 1,600 shares.

b.p: A J Packaging IPO is priced at ₹175-180 per share with a total issue size of 54 crore. The IPO has a lot size of 800 shares and will be listed on NSE SME.

A J Packaging financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Incorporated in the year 1995, A J packaging is an entity engaged in producing a wide variety of metal tin cans in different shapes like oval, rectangular, and round shapes with capacities ranging from 50 grams to 500 grams and 50 ml to 5000 ml. A J packaging offers a broad range of products including printed, lacquered, embossed, uniquely shaped and fully customized metal cans. The products are designed to cater to the packaging needs of different solid, powdered, and liquid products. The firm follows B2B business model. · · Products: · Oval shaped Cans · Round shaped Cans (locking mechanism) · Round shaped Cans (welding mechanism) · Rectangular/ square shaped cans · Embossed and shaped cans · · The company supplies its products to different known firms like CCL Products (India) Limited, Indus Coffee, Vayhan Coffee, Modigold and Beverages, Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Limited, Haldirams Foods International Private Limited, R K Ganapathi Chettiar, SLN Coffee Private Limited, Marino Foods Private Limited, and Asian Paints Limited.The company has manufacturing facilities located in Hyderabad (Telangana), Ghaziabad (Uttar Pradesh), and Khandala (Maharashtra). It effectively services leading FMCG brands and the paint industry in both domestic and international markets. · · As on June 30, 2026, the company had employed around 109 individuals, comprising skilled, semi-skilled, and unskilled workers across various functions.
Ajay Agarwal, Nitin Agarwal, Ranjani Agarwal, A J Cans Pvt.Ltd. are the company's promoters of A J Packaging.
